FUN_0014ca80 handles resource state 3, resolves the resource handle, reads image width/height via FUN_002209a0, computes the draw rectangle from layout and dimensions, and calls FUN_0015e2e0.

FUN_001595f0 installs FUN_00159080. FUN_00159080 obtains a resource through class getters, checks readiness, reads dimensions with FUN_002209a0, builds the image rectangle, and calls FUN_0015e2e0.

FUN_00156e28 calls FUN_00156c40 and installs FUN_00156f70 in the class setter table. FUN_001566b0 obtains a ready graphic resource, reads width/height via FUN_002209a0, computes a draw rectangle using UI layout flags, and calls FUN_0015e2e0.

base_image_upload.cell_iteration: FUN_0021fd50 loops rows/columns from parsed header values, reads each same-index 16-byte cell record at object+0x44 (U/V extents at +0/+4, descriptor pointer at +8), computes cell origins from header stride/cell and image width/height, then calls FUN_00220fe0 per descriptor.
base_image_upload.evidence: Saved function body FUN_00220fe0 calls FUN_00222110 using descriptor+0x28 data, format byte at +0x34, and descriptor dimension bits at +0x38; it does not load +0x2c or +0x35. This is a base image sprite path and is distinct from mip-aware FUN_00222358.

unresolved_join.claim: The type-1 CARS reward asset request is attached to a specific reward-screen UI object class and its draw route.
unresolved_join.resolved_fact: The request is indexed by reward item, bound to BUTTON1 or BUTTON2 via gp-0x5370+s7, and set through that button node’s class-3 setter. Class-3 button rendering uses FUN_00159080 -> FUN_0015e2e0 -> FUN_00220678 -> FUN_0021fd50 -> FUN_00220fe0.
unresolved_join.runtime_limit: Static control flow does not prove the async gate/poll conditions completed in a particular emulator state, nor does it show output pixels or GS alpha blending.

conclusion: The source-derived CARS reward-icon path is now connected: the type-1 CARS template loads into the same-index BUTTON1/BUTTON2 UI node (class 3), whose class-selected renderer uses the main-image sprite uploader. The uploader ignores descriptor +0x2c/+0x35, so serialized mip sentinels do not block this CARS reward-icon route. FUN_0022acc8 builds same-index cell/descriptor links, and FUN_0021fd50 renders the row-major grid using the verified U/V edge fractions. Static code proves the route conditionally; a captured menu draw is still needed to validate actual pixels, alpha and runtime reachability.

render_grid_composition.parser: FUN_0022acc8 sets runtime image dimensions from header words 5/6 at object+0x14/+0x18; header stride/cell fields occupy +0x0c/+0x10; row/column counts are +0x08/+0x04. It sets object+0x44 to the 16-byte per-tile record array and writes the same-index descriptor pointer to each record+8.
render_grid_composition.renderer: FUN_0021fd50 loops rows from object+0x08 and columns from object+0x04. For each 16-byte cell record, it reads normalized U/V extents from record+0/+4 and calls FUN_00220fe0 on the descriptor pointer from record+8.
render_grid_composition.position_and_extent: The renderer advances cell origins by xStep=(right-left)*object.stride/object.imageWidth and yStep=(bottom-top)*object.cell/object.imageHeight. Each cell quad ends at originX+xStep*record.U and originY+yStep*record.V. The recorded U/V fractions are 1.0 for full cells and equal to clipped image remainder divided by 32 for edge cells. This establishes row-major descriptor-cell composition and edge extents in the source display path.
render_grid_composition.source_image_placement_equivalence: The decoder places source pixels at x=(index mod columns)*32 and y=floor(index/columns)*32, clipping to declared image dimensions. This agrees with source renderer cell-origin increments and serialized per-cell U/V edge fractions when cell dimensions/stride are 32; record/descriptor payload association is same-index in FUN_0022acc8.
render_grid_composition.limits: The source renderer establishes the per-cell display geometry for parsed texture objects; it does not establish that the dynamic CARS request is attached to any particular REWRD.UI object, nor channel/alpha blending or observed output pixels.

cars_callback_join.button_array_global: gp-0x5370 (the same address shown as gp0xffffac90 in FUN_00181f38)
cars_callback_join.button_object_creation: FUN_00181f38 formats BUTTON%d at VA 0x25d110 with values 1 and 2, looks each name up under the UIREWRD.UI root at VA 0x25d0e0, and stores the returned node pointers at array indexes 0 and 1 (byte offsets 0 and 4). The archived REWRD.UI defines both as UI_TYPE_BUTTON, class id 3.
cars_callback_join.reward_iteration: FUN_001820f0 starts reward index at stack+0x58=0, forms s7=index*4 at VA 0x182194, uses gp-0x5370+s7 to fetch the current button node, and increments through the reward-item count. This reuses the same BUTTON1/BUTTON2 pointer array created by FUN_00181f38.
cars_callback_join.cars_dispatch: Callback switches on one-based reward type at VA 0x1821f4. The type-1 jump-table entry at VA 0x25d2f0 targets 0x182220. That case formats GRAPHICS\GAME\CARS\%s.PSD (string VA 0x25d1c0), then calls FUN_0022a910 with load type 2.
cars_callback_join.returned_handle_setter: On the completion path, VA 0x1826d8 loads button object from gp-0x5370+s7 and the same-index resource handle from gp-0x6018+s7, reads the button class id, indexes setter table DAT_00239a20 by class id, and calls the setter with (button,handle). Because BUTTON1/2 class id is 3, FUN_0014d728 stores the handle at node+0x154.
cars_callback_join.runtime_condition: This proves the static resource-to-UI wiring when the conditional async callback reaches the type-1 CARS case and completion path. It does not prove that loader gates/polling completed in a captured runtime state.
